incident-bot: PagerDuty → SERVICE: inference-api: p99 latency breach (SLO p99 > 500ms). Triggered 3x in 5m. Pager: oncall-engineering
anya: acked PD, I'm on it. grabbing traces and looking at recent deploys
leo: seeing p95 jump too, esp us-west-2. KV cache evictions spiked ~30s ago :eyes:
maria: confirmed eviction spike on cache-evict metric, background compactor running hot? checking sidecar CPU
sre-bot: metric alert: kvcache_evictions{region="us-west-2"} > 100 for 00:03:00
anya: rolling tail logs for candidate pods:
anya: ```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-runtime --since=10m | grep -i eviction | tail -n 50
# seeing repeated small KV eviction messages and transient OOM-suppress
```
leo: any recent model rollouts? canary>stable switch? deployment history shows a bump 8m ago to model v3-opt
maria: yes, model v3-opt went stable ~9m ago. It uses larger KV footprints, could be memory pressure
anya: temporarily routing 10% of traffic to fallback model v2-quant to reduce KV pressure. updating routing policy now
anya: ```
redwoodctl route set inference-api --weight model:v2-quant=10% model:v3-opt=90%
``` 
sre-bot: routing API: policy applied, 10% diverted
leo: observing p99 drop on the diverted nodes within 60s, overall p99 still elevated but trending down :thumbsup:
maria: scaling up dedicated pool by +2 nodes as a precaution
maria: ```
autoscaler scale inference-dedicated --add 2 --region us-west-2
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: Acknowledged by anya. Escalation policy not triggered.
anya: collecting customer impact: error rates unchanged, but tail latency causing degraded UX for long completions (>2s). No new customer tickets yet
leo: attaching quick flamegraph snippet: traces show heavy KV lookup stalls during warmup phase
anya: plan: keep partial diversion to v2, scale +2, monitor KV evictions; if p99 doesn't < 500ms within 10m, re-route 50% and prepare rollback of v3-opt
sam: taking over if this persists into the night; ping me in 10m if not stable
anya: will update in 5m with metrics and then handoff if needed
sre-bot: next update in 5 minutes scheduled
maria: note added to incident timeline: root cause suspected model v3-opt increased KV working set leading to eviction cascade
anya: update: p99 now 430ms, p95 back to normal. keeping diversion at 10% for 3 more minutes then will incrementally revert if stable
sam: thanks — I'll be ready to take the bridge if it re-escalates
anya: handing to sam for longer monitoring in 20m window, leaving runbook steps in thread. closing active PD ack once stable for 15m
incident-bot: PD: incident status -> acknowledged. Will auto-resolve if no new triggers in 15m.
